_comment: Hooks dispatch to .claude/hooks/dispatcher.py. Python 3.8+ required. Uses python3 (macOS/Linux); Windows install creates a python3 shim.

hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}/.claude/hooks/dispatcher.py"; [ -n "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ] && [ -f "$d" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 "$d" session-start
d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}/.claude/hooks/dispatcher.py"; [ -n "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ] && [ -f "$d" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 "$d" pre-tool
d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}/.claude/hooks/dispatcher.py"; [ -n "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ] && [ -f "$d" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 "$d" user-prompt
d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}/.claude/hooks/dispatcher.py"; [ -n "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ] && [ -f "$d" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 "$d" post-tool
d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}/.claude/hooks/dispatcher.py"; [ -n "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ] && [ -f "$d" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 "$d" stop
d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}/.claude/hooks/dispatcher.py"; [ -n "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ] && [ -f "$d" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 "$d" session-end
